import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;

    static class Edge {
        int to, reverse;
        long flow, capacity, cost;

        Edge(int to, int reverse, long flow, long capacity, long cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.reverse = reverse;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        int nodes;
        List<List<Edge>> graph;
        long[] dist, pot;
        int[] par_node, par_edge;
        boolean[] visited;

        MinCostFlow(int n) {
            nodes = n;
            graph = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            dist = new long[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            pot = new long[n];
            par_node = new int[n];
            par_edge = new int[n];
            visited = new boolean[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, long cap, long cost) {
            graph.get(from).add(new Edge(to, graph.get(to).size(), 0, cap, cost));
            graph.get(to).add(new Edge(from, graph.get(from).size() - 1, 0, 0, -cost));
        }

        boolean dijkstra(int src, int dst, long lb) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            Arrays.fill(visited, false);
            dist[src] = 0;
            PriorityQueue<Pair> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(p -> p.first));
            pq.offer(new Pair(0, src));

            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                Pair p = pq.poll();
                long d = p.first;
                int u = (int) p.second;
                if (visited[u]) continue;
                visited[u] = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < graph.get(u).size(); ++i) {
                    Edge e = graph.get(u).get(i);
                    if (e.flow <= e.capacity - lb && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.to] + e.cost) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.to] + e.cost;
                        par_node[e.to] = u;
                        par_edge[e.to] = i;
                        pq.offer(new Pair(dist[e.to], e.to));
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[dst] < INF;
        }

        long[] augment(int src, int dst) {
            long flow = INF;
            for (int v = dst; v != src; v = par_node[v]) {
                Edge e = graph.get(par_node[v]).get(par_edge[v]);
                flow = Math.min(flow, e.capacity - e.flow);
            }
            long cost = 0;
            for (int v = dst; v != src; v = par_node[v]) {
                Edge e = graph.get(par_node[v]).get(par_edge[v]);
                e.flow += flow;
                Edge rev = graph.get(v).get(e.reverse);
                rev.flow -= flow;
                cost += flow * rev.cost;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < nodes; ++i) {
                if (dist[i] < INF) pot[i] += dist[i];
            }
            return new long[]{flow, cost};
        }

        long compute(int src, int dst, long[] totalCost) {
            totalCost[0] = 0;
            long totalFlow = 0;

            for (long lb = 1L << 30; lb > 0; lb >>= 1) {
                while (dijkstra(src, dst, lb)) {
                    long[] result = augment(src, dst);
                    totalFlow += result[0];
                    totalCost[0] += result[1];
                }
            }
            return totalFlow;
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        long first;
        int second;

        Pair(long first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int source = 0;
        int sink = n * T + 1;
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(sink + 1);

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            mcf.addEdge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) {
            mcf.addEdge(1 + t * n, sink, INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
                    mcf.addEdge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < C; ++j) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; ++t) {
                    mcf.addEdge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, (long) cost * d + c);
                    mcf.addEdge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, (long) cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] price = new long[1];
        long flow = mcf.compute(source, sink, price);
        assert flow == k;
        System.out.println(price[0]);
    }
}
